clips.title: The story
paras: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Ken'zigla prepares a bitter draught for the gravely wounded. A careful half dose restores enough strength to move, while more can make a patient bleed out.

Ken'zigla prepares the draught in the Stonetalon Mountains for those near death. Its strength must be measured with care: more than half a dose at once can make the patient bleed out as their circulation surges. Half a dose gives a wounded person enough vigor to move and flee danger. The rest must wait until the body steadies after a full night's rest.
